protocol.context_audio: same query speech follows either 2.56s silence or one unrelated training-speaker utterance; AOSC mode imports a fixed profile made only from eight training speakers
protocol.features: three taps compared at matching target-relative 80ms timestamps; fresh baseline comes from the bulk extraction record
protocol.target_speakers: ten per fold (five from registry8 and five unknown), two independent query utterances each
protocol.threshold: fixed selected-head threshold calibrated on calibration speakers for 10s enrollment and 3s query; reused unchanged under all context modes
